title: RAG Chunk Schema
description: Data contract for the AI Solution Architect RAG layer. The TOP-LEVEL validation target is one flat runtime Chunk as emitted by architect.retrieve_chunks() and web_search_fallback() and consumed as KBChunk(**chunk) by pipeline/agents/researcher.py. The schema follows the implementation (pipeline/state.py KBChunk), not the other way around. Rule-based, no LLM evaluation.

Chunk.description: One retrieved chunk, flat. KB chunks (box 1/2) come from Chroma with a numeric distance; web-fallback chunks (box 3) come from Google-Search grounding with distance null.

source.description: Origin file path/document title (KB) or grounded source URI/title (web).

page.description: Source page number (0/1-based per ingestion convention); 0 for web chunks.

box.description: Semantic bucket: 1 = curated architecture patterns, 2 = domain knowledge, 3 = live web-search fallback.

distance.description: Chroma distance, lower = better match. Numeric for KB chunks (box 1/2); null for box-3 web-fallback chunks.

RetrievalResponse.description: JSON-equivalent of the Python boundary: architect.retrieve_chunks(query, k) returns the tuple (chunks, origin). Position 0 is the array of Chunk (ordered best/lowest distance first; KB path filtered by DISTANCE_THRESHOLD), position 1 is the origin string. This two-item array is a serialization convention for the tuple, NOT a runtime object shape.
